title: Multilingual Large Language Models: A Systematic Survey

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluated using specific benchmarks such as WinoMT for measuring gender bias in translation, DisCo (Discovery of Correlations) for measuring unfairness in gender prediction, and the Multilingual Bias Evaluation (MBE) score in high-resource languages.

Analyzed via interpretability methods to observe performance disparities and distribution imbalances favoring high-resource languages (particularly English) over low-resource languages, including studying the conceptual space representations of different language tokens.

Assessed by probing large language models for cross-cultural differences in values and multicultural knowledge using culturally diverse datasets (e.g., the World Values Survey) and evaluating pluralistic cultural alignment.
